verdict.rationale: Fern auto-generates and maintains `llms.txt` and serves clean Markdown when `.md`/`.mdx` is appended to a page URL. It also supports custom agent directives and tracks llms.txt traffic by LLM provider. A live probe confirmed `buildwithfern.com/llms.txt` returns HTTP 200 with an 'Instructions for AI Agents' section, and `.md` pages such as `/sdks.md` and `/cli.md` are retrievable. Missing for 10: a consistent Markdown path at the docs root (`/learn.md` returned 404), and independent community corroboration of agent use.
